mapper.select: SELECT p.field_cd, c.code_nm AS field_nm, p.screen_mask_yn, p.excel_mask_yn, a.admin_nm AS mod_nm, p.mod_dt FROM tb_masking_policy p LEFT JOIN tb_code c ON c.group_cd = 'PRIVACY_FIELD' AND c.code = p.field_cd LEFT JOIN tb_admin a ON a.admin_id = p.mod_id ORDER BY c.sort_ord, p.field_cd
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_masking_policy SET screen_mask_yn = #{screenMaskYn}, excel_mask_yn = #{excelMaskYn}, mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE field_cd = #{fieldCd} AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)
